description: This file defines an Angular service class 'EntityViewService' that provides methods for interacting with entity view data via HTTP API calls, including CRUD operations, querying, and association management within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: EntityViewService
classes.description: Angular injectable service for managing entity views, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and association with customers and edges.

methods.name: getTenantEntityViewInfos
methods.description: Fetches entity view info for a tenant with optional filtering by type.

methods.name: getCustomerEntityViewInfos
methods.description: Retrieves entity view info for a specific customer, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getEntityView
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EntityView by its ID.

methods.name: getEntityViews
methods.description: Retrieves multiple EntityViews by their IDs.

methods.name: getEntityViewInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed info for a specific EntityView.

methods.name: saveEntityView
methods.description: Creates or updates an EntityView, with optional save parameters.

methods.name: deleteEntityView
methods.description: Deletes an EntityView by its ID.

methods.name: assignEntityViewToCustomer
methods.description: Associates an EntityView with a customer.

methods.name: unassignEntityViewFromCustomer
methods.description: Removes association of an EntityView from a customer.

methods.name: findByQuery
methods.description: Searches for EntityViews based on a query.

methods.name: assignEntityViewToEdge
methods.description: Associates an EntityView with an edge.

methods.name: unassignEntityViewFromEdge
methods.description: Removes association of an EntityView from an edge.

methods.name: getEdgeEntityViews
methods.description: Retrieves EntityViews associated with a specific edge, with pagination and filtering.
